blurbs.SUPPORTER: The small bracket — make the forum yours, without the AI extras.
blurbs.DONOR: Back the community and unlock AI answers.
blurbs.PRO: For businesses and people offering services.

pitches.SUPPORTER: The entry bracket for people who want to chip in and personalize how the forum looks and reads. It covers profile and feed customization, and deliberately leaves out AI — if you want Ask AI, the Donor tier is the one you want.
pitches.DONOR: Donor keeps the lights on and unlocks Ask AI: instant answers about jobs, housing and life abroad. It includes everything in Supporter.
pitches.PRO: Professional is for anyone running a business or offering services to the community. It adds a business listing in the directory on top of everything Donor includes.
